title: Upcycling polyethylene into diesel-range hydrocarbons over Ru catalysts confined in thermally stable mesoporous N-doped carbon
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01013F, Paper
Shitong Yu, Zhenghang Ren, Kaige Wang, Rui Xiao, Zhicheng Luo, Huiyan Zhang
Ultrasmall Ru nanoparticles confined in mesoporous N-doped carbon enable solvent-free polyethylene hydrogenolysis, achieving 86.5% liquid yield and 90.4% selectivity toward C8–C22 hydrocarbons under mild conditions.
